name: Zauner SIC conjecture
question: Do SIC equiangular complex lines exist in every finite dimension d at least two?
first_attack: Verify small-dimension SICs using exact algebraic arithmetic; audit uniform constructions and their Galois assumptions
dispatch_next: Extend the cyclotomic engine to the number fields needed for d = 4..8 and replay published exact fiducials there.
dispatch_why: Exact fiducials for dimensions above 3 are published, and the cyclotomic engine does not yet replay them.

campaign.hypothesis: Exact families of d^2 equiangular lines exist beyond individually constructed dimensions.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Replay a published exact fiducial beyond d = 3 with exact arithmetic, and state the precise Galois hypotheses of any proposed uniform family.
campaign.next_experiment: Extend the cyclotomic engine to the number fields needed for d = 4..8 and replay published exact fiducials there.
campaign.falsification: An exact failed Gram matrix relation or a missing required vector under the stated algebraic construction.
campaign.blocker: Exact fiducials beyond d = 3 live in larger number fields than the current Z[zeta_m] engine supports; floating-point SICs are not proofs.

probes.name: Zauner SIC conjecture
probes.title: Exact SIC-POVMs in d = 2 (tetrahedron) and d = 3 (Weyl-Heisenberg in Z[w])
probes.frontier: Known: exact SICs are known in many dimensions and numerical ones far beyond; no construction for every d. d = 2, 3 are classical (Zauner 1999, Renes et al. 2004).

smoke.scope: d=2: 4 exact equiangular qubit states with overlap 1/3; d=3: every Weyl-Heisenberg fiducial with entries in {0, +-1, +-w, +-w^2} found and its 9 states certified with pairwise squared overlap 1/4.

deep.scope: d=2: 4 exact equiangular qubit states with overlap 1/3; d=3: every Weyl-Heisenberg fiducial with entries in {a + b*w : a, b in [-1, 1]} found and its 9 states certified with pairwise squared overlap 1/4.

milestones.title: Exact SIC-POVMs in dimensions 2 and 3
milestones.scope: Classical small dimensions; says nothing about general d
milestones.description: d = 2 tetrahedron overlaps 1/3 exactly; in d = 3 all 108 Weyl-Heisenberg fiducials with entries in {0, +-1, +-w, +-w^2} found in exact Z[w] arithmetic, each Gram matrix recomputed independently.
